transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... for a long time now, I just wake up already feeling pretty low. It's like... I don't know, just this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic for work. And... yeah. It pretty much just follows me through the whole day.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with people?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just kind of... do what I need to do every day. So, not really.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days, even when you haven't done much physically?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Even if I have a day off or sleep late... my body just feels worn out. And then by the time I finish rooming patients and catching up on charts at work... I don't really have anything left. Like... I can't even get my laundry done, or... shoot hoops, or mess with my electronics stuff. Just... yeah. No energy.
Do you feel down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Um... yeah, I guess so. Like I said before... it's just this heavy, gray feeling. It's there when I wake up... and it doesn't really go away. So, yeah... most of the day, I guess.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or have been blaming yourself for things more than usual?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really think about that kind of stuff. Just... try to get through the day, I guess. So... no.
Have you noticed any trouble focusing on tasks, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?

Um... yeah, a little, I guess. Like... at work, I'll just be staring at the intake screen. I have to... read the same thing a few times to get it. And... I don't know, I guess I've missed some small stuff. Like... a dose, or forgetting what I was gonna ask. Just... hard to focus, I guess.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you're more restless or fidgety than before?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I move the same, I guess. Nothing like that.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even things that would normally make you happy?
Um... I don't know. I guess I don't really do much anymore. Just... go to work, come home. I don't really have anything I... enjoy doing right now. So... yeah, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way, with this low mood and lack of energy?

Um... a long time, I guess. Like... two years? Maybe two years and a couple months. It kind of... started when the staffing changed at the clinic. My schedule just started rotating all over the place, so... yeah. Since around then.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining a lot without trying?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, my clothes still fit the same, so... I don't think so.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living, or had thoughts about harming yourself?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't know. I just feel tired. But... no.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, even if others around you noticed it and you didn’t act like your usual self?
Um... no. I don't think so. I've never really felt energetic like that. Just... mostly the opposite, I guess.
Before this current period of low mood, have you ever had a time when you felt down or depressed for more than two weeks in a row?
Um... I'm not really sure. It's just... it feels like it's kind of always been this way, I think. I don't really remember a specific time before this.
Before this current period of low mood, have you ever had another time when you felt down or depressed for more than two weeks in a row?
Um... didn't you just ask that? I... I don't really know what else to say. Like I said, I don't really remember a time before this. It's just... always been like this.

Before this current time that you’ve been feeling down and tired, can you recall if you had any separate periods where you felt depressed for more than two weeks, even if they got better before this started?

I... I really don't know what else to tell you. You're asking the exact same thing again. 

There aren't... separate times. It never got better. It's just... always.

Before this current period of feeling down and tired, have you ever had any times where you felt significantly better for a while—like a clear change from your current state—before feeling down again?
No... I don't. I don't remember ever feeling better for a while, or... having a clear change. It's just... it's always just been this.
Have there been any times when you felt completely back to normal—like your usual self—without this heavy, gray feeling, even for a while, before things got bad again?
I... I don't know how else to say it. No. There's no "usual self" to go back to. It's just... this.
Have there ever been times when you felt completely free of this heavy, gray feeling—like a remission—where things were noticeably better, even for a few weeks or months, before getting worse again?
I... I just told you. No. It doesn't go away. I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing.
